identification: One strapped pack of new, unfinished solid Tasmanian oak tongue and groove flooring, handwritten batten 'APPROX 10.0 M/2 TAS OAK T+G FLOORING'. End view shows about 6 boards across by about 15 layers, board face roughly 65 mm (consistent with catalogue 65x20). Random lengths: one end square, the other end ragged with many short boards; longest boards look about 1.8-2.4 m against the forklift in photo 1. Clean, bright, no finish, no visible borer or stain.
